title: French and Francophone Studies, B.A. -- Language and Culture Option (College of the Liberal Arts)
notes: Pre-LA-83/283 curriculum (see FRENCHBA-2025.json / FRENCHBA-2026.json for the post-2025 version). Built from the archived 2022-23 bulletin's Suggested Academic Plan for the Language and Culture Option -- pre-2025 catalogs published only ONE combined SAP table for this option, headed 'at University Park Campus and Commonwealth Campuses' (not the separate University-Park/Commonwealth tables that appear starting the 2025-26 catalog); the other two options (Language and Literature, Language and Linguistics) still describe requirements only in prose, same reasoning FRENCHBA-2026.json's own note gives for choosing this option. Verified via raw HTML <table class="sc_plangrid"> row-by-row parsing (curl + BeautifulSoup, not WebFetch's AI summary, per this batch's known hallucination risk) and cross-checked against the page's own printed per-semester subtotals: 16+16+14.5+15+15+15+13.5+15=120, matching both the SAP's own 'Total Credits 120' footer and the Program Requirements table's 45(GenEd)+18(Electives)+24(B.A. Reqs)+33(Major)=120. Real, confirmed differences from FRENCHBA-2026.json for this catalog year: (1) No LA 83 / LA 283 Liberal Arts Seminar requirement existed yet. Semester 1 is a flat 16cr (FR 1, ENGL 15, GEN ED GQ, GEN ED N, GEN ED) with no 1.5cr LA 83 slot; Semester 4 is 15cr with a second full 3cr GEN ED slot standing in place of 2026's 1.5cr 'Second-Year Liberal Arts Seminar' slot. This 3-credit LA 83+LA 283 add-on is confirmed (by directly fetching and diffing the 2022-23, 2023-24, and 2024-25 archives against each other) to first appear starting the 2025-26 catalog -- see FRENCHBA-2025.json's own note. (2) The Fourth Year Spring B.A. elective slot is labeled 'B.A. Other Cultures Course (or Elective)' this year; it was renamed 'B.A. World Cultures Course (or Elective)' starting the 2024-25 catalog (matches FRENCHBA-2026.json's wording) -- this file uses the period-accurate 'Other Cultures' label. (3) Course titles differ cosmetically only (FR 351 was 'French and Francophone Literature I', FR 352 was 'French and Francophone Literature II' this year, later renamed) -- not stored in this JSON's schema (options are codes only), so no functional effect. Same real ambiguity FRENCHBA-2026.json's own note documents, present identically in this year's own SAP table: it hardcodes 'FR 316' alone in Third Year Fall, but the Common Requirements/Option Requirements text explicitly says 'Select one of the following: FR 316, FR 417, FR 418, FR 419' (3cr) -- resolved the same way, as a 4-way options pool. The FR 331/332/351/352 pool appears 3 times in this year's own SAP table too (1x Third Year Fall, 2x Third Year Spring, 9cr total) matching the Common Requirements text's 'Select three of the following: 9cr' and FRENCHBA-2026.json's already-fixed 3-occurrence structure. Entrance to Major (2.00 cumulative GPA, third-semester classification) is textually identical to the 2026-27 catalog. Campus-availability boilerplate ('Begin Campus: Any Penn State Campus' / 'End Campus: University Park') on this archived page reads identically to the live 2026-27 page, but per this task's Part 2 scope that finding/field is only recorded on FRENCHBA-2026.json itself, not duplicated here.
